children: Royal Gold Inc. (RGLD) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 04, 2026.
On November 4, 2026, Royal Gold, Inc. reported its results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.

The information furnished under this Item 2.02, including the exhibit, will not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, and will not be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, except as expressly set forth by reference to such filing.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/85535/000008553526000049/rgld-20261104.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/85535/000008553526000049/0000085535-26-000049-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
